BiblicalUsage: Geah is arrogance, the pride that God hates. It appears once, in Proverbs 8:13, where the fear of the LORD is to hate evil — pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate. The word stands in wisdom's own list of the things God hates.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe arrogance is the first thing wisdom names because it is the root of the rest; pride, the evil way, and the froward mouth all grow from the same root, and I hold that the fear of the LORD begins where arrogance ends.
RelatedTopics: Pride; Wisdom; Fear of the Lord
